verdict.rationale: Poly documents an official hosted MCP server at https://mcp.poly.app/mcp over streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in and no API keys. Its official Claude Code plugin connects that server, and the MCP usage docs describe guardrails such as blocking irreversible deletes. A first-party polymcp GitHub repo adds time-travel listing and reading of past file revisions. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works as documented, and a complete enumerated tool catalogue in the evidence.
